incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> HIGH latency spike for service="inference-service-prod". Trigger: latency_p90 > 350ms for 5m. Primary oncall: Priya. PD: https://pagerduty/INC12345
Priya (oncall): Acked. looking into it now.
Priya (oncall): Any obvious customer-facing errors? status pages?
Ethan: No 5xx increase. Just latency across eu-west-1. Running quick query on router buckets to confirm: `sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5"}[1m])) by (instance)`
Zoe: I'll start trace sampling for the hot route `/v1/generate`. @Miguel can you check dedicated GPU pools and worker health?
Miguel: Dedicated pools appear healthy. One worker did reboot ~10m ago — kube logs show a kill: `kill -9 /worker` at 15:12 UTC. grabbing full logs now.
Priya (oncall): If it's a single worker fail, we can cordon and restart, but want to rule out autoscaler thrash. Ethan, any autoscaler chatter?
Ethan: Autoscaler CPU bumped briefly but not thrashing. I do see a KV cache coldstart storm matching the timing — lots of prefix misses around 15:09-15:13. that will blow up p90 while caches warm.
Priya (oncall): OK let's try manual KV warmup: `/admin/kv/warmup --prefix inference:v2`
Zoe: Warming now. Also enabling short-term routing fallback to a lighter model: `route-policy set fallback model:gpt-medium --percent 10` to reduce token latency while we stabilize.
ops-bot: Command acknowledged: kv warmup started (task id task_879). Fallback rollout initiated to 10% traffic.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page auto-resolved — condition cleared. latency_p90 dropped below threshold at 15:18 UTC. PD incident auto-closed.
Priya (oncall): Nice. Confirming p90 back to ~140ms in dashboards. No customer-facing 5xx observed. marking as no-customer-impact for now.
Ethan: Logs show KV prefill succeeded and the rebooted worker was OOM'd by a background data-processor (unrelated to core inference path). Filed follow-up: GH-#4567 (memory leak in batch job).
Miguel: I'll add a short-lived monitor on that worker group and increase KV prefill frequency for the next 12h to reduce coldstart risk. Will also plan a controlled restart after peak. Rolling back fallback once metrics stable.
Priya (oncall): Thanks. Handover to next oncall: Zoe — please monitor for 30m and escalate if it comes back.
Zoe: Got it. I'll keep the sampling on and watch the p90 and kv_miss_rate. Adding note to PD: "auto-resolved transient KV coldstart spike; warmed cache + 10% fallback; follow-up GH-#4567"
Priya (oncall): :thumbsup: leaving the channel. No immediate postmortem unless recurrence.
Zoe: Acknowledged. I'll update status if anything changes. (react :eyes:)
